key.year: kpi:key_n — report year, used in the heading and lede (all rows share it)
key.unit_code: skip: numeric unit code, empty for some rows; the unit name is used instead
key.indicator_code: skip: running number within a unit
key.indicator: kpi:key_n — indicator name (row identity and sort key); searchable in the explorer
key.baseline_value: skip: raw indicator values in mixed units; the achievement rate already compares them
key.target_value: skip: raw planned values in mixed units; the achievement rate already compares them
key.actual_value_2025: skip: raw actual values in mixed units; the achievement rate already compares them
key.rate_scale: chart-status, chart-key-units, chart-key-character, chart-scatter, kpi:key_full, kpi:none, insight:key_vs_plan, insight:key_units — capped achievement rate (0..1)
key.public_explanation: insight:transparency — free text; only its presence is counted
key.primary_barrier: skip: 13 non-empty values; barriers are analysed in the work-plan table
key.sub_barrier: skip: mostly empty, mixed with reviewer notes
key.PMO_comments: skip: internal reviewer notes to the ministries
key.Unnamed: 32: skip: spreadsheet helper column, one reviewer note
key.Unnamed: 36: skip: spreadsheet helper column (zeros, one reviewer note)
key.Unnamed: 42: skip: spreadsheet helper column, one reviewer note
plan.year: kpi:plan_n — report year, used in the heading, lede and deadline buckets
plan.unit_code: skip: numeric unit code, inconsistent across names; the unit name is used instead
plan.goal_code: skip: running number within a unit
plan.target_code: skip: running number within a goal
plan.target: kpi:goals — distinct targets, counted in the goals KPI label
plan.task: kpi:goals — distinct tasks, counted in the goals KPI label
plan.indicator: kpi:plan_n — indicator name (row identity and sort key); searchable in the explorer
plan.end_date: chart-deadline, insight:deadline — mixed d/m/Y strings and Excel serial numbers
plan.baseline_value: skip: raw indicator values in mixed units; the achievement rate already compares them
plan.target_value: skip: raw planned values in mixed units; the achievement rate already compares them
plan.value_at_end_date: skip: multi-year target in mixed units
plan.actual_value_2025: skip: raw actual values in mixed units; the achievement rate already compares them
plan.rate_scale: skip: uncapped rate with extreme outliers (up to several hundred times the target); the capped rate_range is used
plan.rate_range: chart-status, chart-ministry, chart-character, chart-deadline, chart-barriers, chart-scatter, kpi:plan_full, kpi:zero, kpi:none, insight:overall, insight:binary, insight:deadline
plan.data_source: skip: free text source names; transparency is measured on the key indicators
plan.public_explanation: skip: free text explanation; searchable in the explorer
plan.primary_barrier: chart-barriers, insight:barrier — normalised (underscores, reviewer notes and placeholders removed)
plan.sub_barrier: skip: mostly reviewer notes to the ministries
